title: Task harness contract
description: Stable harness.json format. It defines every possible score item before runs are executed.

schema.description: Contract discriminator. harness-contract.v1 is the normalized standalone form; task-harness.v1 is the embedded full-task form.

codeLocation.description: Entry point of the executable harness.

harnessCodeLocation.description: Entry point field used by harness-contract.v1.

sourceLocation.description: Task source location used by harness-contract.v1.

scoreItemCount.description: Declared number of scoreItems; must equal scoreItems.length.

scoreItems.description: Ordered scoring rules. Every run report uses these IDs.
